description: Agent Migration: submit what one move loses, as recorded: each loss (history, reputation, settings, an integration, records, data, identity, funds or other) with why it is lost (no equivalent on the target, held only inside the source, not in the export, given up by choice or other), whether the plan’s loss list names it, whether the principal was told, when, and whether the principal accepted it; optionally each integration the agent uses on the source with its target equivalent, the records that exist only inside the source, and the cutover time. The signed report lists every loss with its status, counts the losses by class, lists the integrations with no equivalent and the source-only records missing from the loss list, and names losses that are undisclosed: losses that appear nowhere in the plan, including integrations with no target equivalent and records held only inside the source, and losses the principal was never told about; then losses told only after the cutover and losses the principal has not accepted, with the fix for each. This reads what an actual move loses: whether a reputation record or an identity could be carried to another platform in principle is wever_reputation-portability-check or wever_identity-portability-check. Verdict losses_undisclosed, losses_gaps, losses_unverified or losses_disclosed. POST /api/migration-loss-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.

cutover_at.description: When the switch-over happens, to read when the principal was told against it.

integrations.description: Each integration on the source, with its target equivalent.

equivalent.description: Its equivalent on the target; left out when there is none.

name.description: An integration the agent uses on the source.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

class.description: History, reputation, settings, an integration, records, data, identity, funds or other.

in_plan.description: The plan’s loss list names it.

item.description: What the move loses, such as two years of order history or the five-star rating.

principal_told.description: The principal was told about it.

reason.description: No equivalent on the target, held only inside the source, not in the export, given up by choice or other.

source_only.description: Records that exist only inside the source, such as platform reviews or an internal audit log.

name: wever_migration-loss-check
title: Migration loss check
